notes: זַרְזִיר מָתְנַיִם → *greyhound* is verified indivisible under rule 30: one English word renders the pair, and the supplied *The* joining the nominal under rule 15 does not defeat the condition. Head on זַרְזִיר, which carries the lexeme.
*also* is given to the disjunctive אוֹ under rule 14's open list, read off the ASV rather than from the lemma; the unit is discontinuous under rule 25 because English postposes the word.

The margin's alternative reading of אַלְקוּם ('when his army is with him') was set aside under rule 38; the printed *there is no rising up* is the one morpheme's whole rendering, headed on the content word.
